 Options: Insights from experienced investors 107K Views · 1439 Posts GTA Terminal joined discussion · Nov 20 03:31 Micron Technology (MU) Institutional Flow at 1:45 PM: $376M More in Puts Since 11:45 AM
 $Micron Technology (MU.US)$ : Dark pool trading Nov 18 hit 0.9x a normal day (5-day trend: fading). $MU drew $1.1B in options premium: calls $397.5M, puts $736.6M (65% puts). Largest bet: $31.7M on 7,924 put contracts expiring Nov 20 vs 2,932 open interest. Second biggest: $26.9M on 17,327 puts expiring Nov 20. Price levels to watch: last $700.90, 20-day average $801.32, 50-day average $920.09, 20-day range $656.39 – $983.23.
